sources.title: Poland P0 research batch Issue #275
sources.notes: Defines the Poland research batch and the non-authorizing research boundary.

sources.title: Prepared Binance × Poland Draft PR #276
sources.notes: Prepared task provenance only; not factual market evidence.

sources.title: UKNF reminder on crypto exchanges and Binance Poland
limitations: Historical pre-MiCA regulatory posture; cannot prove current 2026 authorization.
sources.notes: States Binance Poland sp. z o.o. entered the old Polish virtual-currency register on 2022-09-29 and that KNF did not license/supervise such exchanges under that regime.

sources.title: KNF notice on end of MiCA transition for crypto-asset service providers
sources.notes: Confirms Poland's Article 143(3) transition ends 2026-07-01 and discusses wind-down expectations for unauthorized entities.

sources.title: ESMA Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA) — Interim MiCA Register
limitations: The linked authorised-CASP CSV could not be parsed by the available research tooling, so this run does not make a direct row-level absence/presence assertion for Binance.
sources.notes: Register landing page states last update 2026-07-16 and explains that NCAs provide the authorised-CASP data.

sources.title: MiCA Article 59 — Authorisation
sources.notes: States a person shall not provide crypto-asset services in the Union unless authorised under Article 63 or permitted under Article 60.

sources.title: ESMA Q&A 2295 — grandfathering status
sources.notes: Says transitional providers were not MiCA-authorised CASPs and could continue only until the applicable transition ended, no later than 2026-07-01.

sources.title: Binance P2P Express — USDT/PLN public surface
limitations: Public surface visibility does not prove legal authorisation, successful registration, or account-level eligibility for a Polish resident.
sources.notes: Shows public Binance P2P buy/sell interface denominated in PLN.

sources.title: Binance P2P — Santander Poland payment-method surface
limitations: Payment-method page visibility does not prove onboarding or regulatory eligibility for a Polish resident.
sources.notes: Polish-language P2P surface names Santander Poland as a payment method.

sources.title: What Is KYC (Know Your Customer)?
limitations: Platform-general compliance guidance, not Poland-specific onboarding evidence.
sources.notes: States Binance restricts trading and withdrawals until KYC verification is completed.

sources.title: What Is Binance P2P and How to Use It?
limitations: Platform-general P2P rules; not proof that P2P may legally be offered to Polish residents at the checked date.
sources.notes: States all Binance P2P users must complete identity verification.

sources.title: Binance Licenses & Registrations
limitations: The accessible capture did not expose a Poland/MiCA CASP row that could be bound to the Polish market. Absence from the capture is not treated as proof of no licence.
sources.notes: Used only to document that the available official capture was insufficient for a positive Poland MiCA authorization claim.

sources.title: Binance maintains commitment to EU, seeking more licences in Asia
limitations: Secondary reporting; cannot replace the ESMA authorised-CASP register.
sources.notes: Quotes Binance co-CEO Richard Teng saying Binance remained in talks with EU regulators after withdrawing the Greek MiCA application.

sources.title: Scammers pose as watchdogs to exploit EU crypto rule changes
limitations: Secondary reporting; current MiCA register remains the primary authority source.
sources.notes: Reports that Binance had not received EU approval as of 2026-08-06.

sources.title: Binance Poland-language spot BTC/USDT public surface
limitations: A reachable Polish-language spot page does not prove that a Polish resident may onboard or lawfully receive the service.
